`google_robots_conformance.json` contains the robots.txt / user-agent / URL /
expected-result cases extracted from `robots_test.cc` of
https://github.com/google/robotstxt (Copyright 2019 Google LLC, Apache License 2.0,
https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). The cases were extracted as data
(no code was compiled or executed); see `studies/benchmark.py`.
